t: This 4lite Advantage single 5ft LED IP20 batten light is a slimline, polycarbonate lighting solution for various indoor applications. Ideal for workshops, garages, and commercial or industrial settings, it delivers powerful illumination. The integrated LED technology provides 6100 lumens of bright light with a 48W power consumption. Users can select between warm, cool, or daylight white colour temperatures (3000/4000/6500K) to suit different environments. Designed for reliable performance, it features a robust polycarbonate body and metal clips for straightforward ceiling installation.
b: 4 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
Suitable for Both Domestic & Commercial Use
